label: In the same inhabited two-world universal frame, with all two roster members existing everywhere…
meaning: In the same inhabited two-world universal frame, with all two roster members existing everywhere and the concreteness criterion false everywhere, a fixed individual exists necessarily, an accessible world has an empty concrete extension, and necessary concrete exemplification fails. Thus existence alone does not supply the concreteness bridge. This is a theory-relative countermodel, with no assertion that abstract objects exhaust an actual or metaphysically possible world.
